title: Bass & Flinders Gin Masterclass
summary: Three hours at the still in Dromana. Learn how gin actually gets made, blend your own botanicals, and walk out with a 500ml bottle of your own recipe.
accessibilityNotes: Distillery door wheelchair accessible; rooftop access, check with venue
weatherDependency: Indoor masterclass, not weather-dependent; rooftop bar weather-dependent
nearbyAttractions: Crittenden Wines (adjacent suburb); Red Hill Brewery; Mornington Peninsula Chocolaterie
suggestedItineraryPairing: Pair with Dromana wineries: Crittenden; Tuerong; add Peninsula Hot Springs for a full wellness day
editorVerdict: The most hands-on spirits experience on the Peninsula, and the bottle you take home is the reason it's worth the price.
editorNote:
Three hours at Bass & Flinders' Dromana still. You sit down with their gin expert, work through the history, smell every botanical they distil with, and then build your own blend on a small copper still. It ends with a cheese platter, a G&T, and a 500ml bottle of your own recipe labelled with your name.

Best suited to couples, small groups and team days. The graduate masterclass exists if you've done the first one and want to go deeper. Book three to four weeks ahead for a weekend slot.

Pair with lunch at Crittenden or a soak at Peninsula Hot Springs afterwards. Don't drive yourself home, you'll be over.
